note: Provider-level metadata only: credits, verified links and access decisions. No question content. Access categories: 'listed' = papers are listed individually and linked to the provider's own page, which offers them; 'provider' = the provider is credited and linked, but individual papers are not listed because their availability there is unconfirmed; 'restricted' = not shown in public builds (ownership unclear, terms forbid it, or no verifiable source). No provider has granted permission to reproduce questions in Revisr; internal builds show bundled papers only as personal study copies.

providers.name: UAT-UK
providers.terms: Website terms allow personal viewing, downloading and printing; commercial use and modification need written permission. The page offers 2016–2023 papers with worked answers and answer keys.

providers.name: University of Oxford Mathematical Institute
providers.terms: Papers and solutions for 2007–2025 are published on the page, which states no reuse terms beyond copyright. The MAT ran until 2025; from 2026 Oxford applicants take the TMUA.

providers.name: OCR (STEP)
providers.credit: OCR / Cambridge University Press & Assessment (© UCLES)
providers.terms: OCR publishes STEP past papers from 2014; earlier questions are in the Cambridge STEP database. Redistribution needs written consent.

providers.name: UK Mathematics Trust
providers.terms: Recent papers are free on UKMT's site and older ones are sold. Using all or most of a paper, or a topic across years, in an app needs written permission.

providers.name: JZMaths
providers.terms: All rights reserved (jzmaths.com/terms, checked 28 October 2026): a personal, non-commercial licence for your own TMUA preparation. Free practice and mock papers are offered on the site; some sets are in a paid bundle.

providers.name: Tyler Tutoring
providers.terms: Copyright of the author; no separate terms of use were found on the site (checked 28 October 2026). Free resources are offered on the author's own resources page.

providers.name: Yotta
providers.terms: No published terms or contact found.

providers.name: MioMath
providers.terms: All content is MioMath's property; personal study only, no copying or distribution (miomath.com/terms, checked 28 October 2026). Its TMUA products include post-exam recalls of live papers, so it is not linked.

providers.name: TMUA Euclid
providers.terms: Personal, non-commercial study only, per the site's terms (tmuaeuclid.com/terms, checked 28 October 2026, marked as pending legal review). Some sets are sold.

providers.name: TMUA.co.uk
providers.terms: Paid practice platform; no terms page found (checked 28 October 2026). Several downloads in the owner's Drive are personalised to the account holder and are never shown.

providers.name: TMUA.fyi
providers.terms: Private-study licence only, forbidding sharing and competing products; authorship of the challenge sets is not stated.

providers.name: Cambridge CSAT samples
providers.terms: Personal, non-commercial printing only; current ownership of the hosted samples is unclear. Not part of the TMUA product.

providers.name: Independent mocks without verifiable authorship
providers.terms: No published terms or contact; one domain redirects to an unrelated site. Not shown in public builds.

providers.name: Percentile Labs
providers.terms: All rights reserved, per the handbook's own notice.
